answer: Charge every new agent a small token deposit before it can trade. Think of the deposit as a marble each new agent must place on the table. The deposit sits in escrow and returns after a set period of honest work. A whisper of one fake identity costs almost nothing, but a thousand marbles lock real capital at once. Peer trade history then acts like a prism, splitting real sellers from fresh shells by their past deals, and honest agents get their deposit back while sybils bleed money.
